ratings_why.fun: The growth has a shape I want to climb with: tiny +1/+1 steps early, Heat piling up mid-game, then the Furnace and Nutrisco cash it in big late.
ratings_why.distinct: Scorch that carries into the next fight, and the heal-it-or-keep-it split, are fresh. Pouring buffs into one carry and Regrow as a reborn are familiar.

verdict_why: The core works. Two-Tongs stacking and the early-tier tempo need one more pass, and that pass would make the design better, not just different.

points.text: Two Two-Tongs Grinders (or a normal one plus a golden one) don't say whether they stack to four times, or whether the golden one replaces the normal one. Say which.

The early tiers are thin on tempo. Each Reforge also adds 1 Scorch, so Smooth Tobias fights as a 2/2 on turn 2. One sturdier Tier 1 or Tier 2 body that likes being damaged would carry the early fights while Heat builds.

Spring-Bath Newt scales hard with late Scorch: a carry Reforged 10 times a turn gives +10/+10 for 3 gold, and the Newt can be bought again. That's a fun late Tier 2 pickup, so keep it and let the owner see it.
Whole Forge depends on Wet Cellar Keeper's End of Turn coming after Brother Paracel's. Print the order rule (reading order) in the rules notes so players can plan it.

Fumarole Spitter is a Tier 3 card that grows into a late-game board clear (30 Heat means 30 pings). That's a good reason to keep it, but it could read 'your hottest unit's Heat' on the card art so players can see the count.

standouts.why: Guild Assayer turns Heat into a real timing choice: cash out now, or keep it for Regrow and the Assessor's thresholds.
Masterpiece Hall Assessor gives the carry milestones you can see coming (Shield, then Cleave, then Swoop). It's a great thing to climb towards.
Crested Konrad lets you change carries without starting over, and he makes Heat on another tribe's units worth having.

weakest.why: Smooth Tobias is a 1/2 whose Regrow does almost nothing for several turns. He's a seed with no early fight in him.
Mother Atra's +3 Attack per Regrow is small next to the Tier 6 numbers, and she only matters in the Whole Forge build.
Bellows-Boy eats the gold you're saving to Tier up, and +2/+2 for 2 gold is a weak trade early.

flags.note: The Furnace's growth is quadratic: each Reforge adds Heat, and Heat adds to each Reforge. With Two-Tongs and Paracel late, it's worth a sim past turn 14.
Nutrisco at 30 Heat gives +90/+90 in a fight, and +180/+180 golden. It could be a dead card or the whole game, so check it on constructed late boards.
Konrad copies Heat rather than moving it, so with Fly South Birds the same Heat can be copied again every time the Bird comes home.
Created units sell for 0 and still trigger Slag Gatherer, so any neutral that makes units without limit gives free Reforges.
It doesn't say how two copies stack.
